Same template as Richard Yu

Both sell a mechanism named “AI arbitrage”. Both open cold on a montage of broadcast news clips about AI replacing jobs before the founder appears — Jordan Lee's second confirmation video is exactly that. Two unrelated operators do not converge this precisely by accident. Worth finding out who is selling the blueprint.

VERIFIED · both funnels captured and transcribed 31 Jul
Buys VIP → refund plus $27 if unhappy

“If you don't feel you got at least 10 times the value, email support and I will refund every single penny with no questions asked. Plus I'll send you an extra $27 on top just for wasting your time.” Paying a penalty on top of the refund is a sharper risk reversal than money-back, and at $27 it costs almost nothing.

VERIFIED · captured on the fast-track page 31 Jul
The $18,105 average is thin

Presented three times as what “our average client” makes. The footer discloses a survey of 660 businesses with roughly 100 responding — a self-selected sixth of the base, self-reported, almost certainly skewed to winners. If we ever quote a client average, the n belongs beside the number, not in an eight-point footer.

VERIFIED as disclosed · underlying data not auditable
Stays on the list → pitched a Done-For-You service

The real money is not the workshop. By email he sells a DFY service where he builds the agency, finds the first paying client and nine more, and hands over a cash-flowing asset. Guarantee: cash flow within 120 days or your money back. Framed with an investor lens — Buffett and Thiel cannot get that guarantee. A $5,000 discount and only 10 places. Different domain (aiagentmethod.com) and a different legal entity (Growth Partner & Consultancy Ltd, London) from the front end.

VERIFIED · full email pulled from Will's inbox, 29 Jul
Registers on name and email only

The only funnel of the seven with no phone field. Every other one demands a mobile number under autodial consent. Worth testing against our own opt-in — he is clearly willing to trade the number for the conversion.
